title: Summer Movies Clawed Back To $4 Billion
source: North American summer box office (first Friday in May through Labor Day), Comscore/Box Office Mojo totals as reported by Deadline, Variety and TheWrap: 2019 $4.33B; 2020 $0.176B (theatres shut for the pandemic); 2021 $1.74B; 2022 $3.40B; 2023 $4.095B; 2024 $3.68B; 2025 $3.67B, down 0.2% year over year and short of the hoped-for $4B; 2026 crossed $4.0B in mid-August with the season still running, the second $4B summer since the pandemic, driven by 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' — a record $360M domestic opening and the biggest overall box-office weekend ever at $436.6M — plus 'The Odyssey'. The flat comparison line is summer 2013's $4.755B, still the all-time seasonal record. The 2026 figure is season-to-date and will finish higher.
